overview: Historian Dr Onyeka Nubia examines the history of Victorian Britain by visiting various regions to better understand this period's complex history, which included societal changes, technological advancement, and injustice.
title: Walking Victorian Britain

overview: True crime series exploring horrific murders and the part forensic science played in finding the killers.
title: Forensics: Catching the Killer

overview: Nick Knowles follows the restoration work of historical buildings in need of restoration, showing the results and diving into the history of the building.
title: Nick Knowles Heritage Rescue

overview: Alex Brooker and Josh Widdicombe spend the night at some of the UK's most exciting attractions with no other visitors around.
title: One Night in...

overview: Handan who carried her first baby in her arms when she herself was still considered a child and has since given birth to two more, works as a private customer assistant in a well-known fashion workshop in Nişantaşı. Handan begins attending dress rehearsals at Zerrin and Dündar Demir's home ahead of their wedding anniversary and during this period, Handan and her children's life, which attracts the attention of Dündar, will change after Zerrin and Dündar's wedding anniversary party.
title: Annemizi Saklarken

overview: Anne Dupraz, a respected prosecutor in Geneva, is in custody for shooting a man, now between life and death. She admits her guilt but seems unable to explain her act. Her interrogation and that of her relatives will allow Anne to finally free herself from her past.
title: Sacha

overview: Errol Flynn was probably spinning in his grave, but Mel Brooks's version of the antics of Robin Hood and his band of merry men is a laugh-getter. Though it's primarily a one-joke affair, Mel Brooks's brand of madness and a good cast, particularly Richard Dimitri playing the dual role of the foppish Bertram and a Chicago member of Robin's band called Renaldo, carry it off with all comedic stops pulled.
title: When Things Were Rotten

overview: Seventy years ago, a murderous Bigfoot-like creature sent residents fleeing from Portlock, Alaska. Now, an expedition returns to the abandoned fishing village to determine if the terrifying beast locals call Nantinaq will allow it to be safely resettled.
title: Alaskan Killer Bigfoot

overview: Ki Jin is a budding fashion design student who dreams big: He wants to become a world-famous clothing designer. But the journey to the top of South Korea's fashion tree is not an easy one, and he is struggling to find the right path. One day, on the street, he bumps into Young Woo, an ever-optimistic part-time delivery worker. Even though it seems everyone he knows has formulated a grand plan about how their future will unfurl, Young Woo doesn't have a dream. While all others are in a rush to get somewhere in life, it seems that his own life is stuck in first gear. Although things have got off to a decidedly shaky start for Ki Jin and Young Woo, they start to develop a fondness for one another, and start to wonder if their seemingly opposing blend of determinedness and acceptance could be a case of "opposites attract." But when a leading model named Lee Bin arrives on the scene, things get complicated. He starts to develop a crush on Ki Jin. Could this development spell the end for the fledgling romance between Ki Jin and Young Woo?
title: Behind Cut

overview: A recently divorced reporter moves back to her hometown of Nantes with her daughter, but painful memories await her there… When she was just 16, her Jehovah's Witness parents forced her to give up her newborn son, a decision that drove her to run away from home and leave Nantes.
title: Ben

overview: Get Millie Black follows ex-Scotland Yard detective Millie-Jean Black who returns home to Jamaica after her mother's passing and joins the Kingston police force. When a local girl disappears, Millie and her partner uncover ties to a prominent family — just as a Scotland Yard inspector arrives with his own agenda. Haunted by the ghosts of a sibling who refuses to be saved and a child who can't be found, Millie's search for the truth leads her on an intercontinental chase that threatens to blow up her world.
title: Get Millie Black

overview: The fusion of a human's fighting spirit with a powerful robotic machine built for destruction has become a reality. This extraordinary series features twelve teams consisting of a fighter (a "robo-jockey") and a robotics engineer (a "robo-tech") from myriad backgrounds including a race car driver, an Olympic athlete, a National Guard helicopter pilot along with a mix of professional fighters and software engineers. Each team is paired with its own unique robot and will fight in a first-of-its kind competition using a high-tech exo-suit that translates their movements to their robot. Each fight consists of three rounds of intense action, with the winning team advancing in the competition.
title: Robot Combat League

overview: Love and Fortune is the story of Chok, a very unlucky young man where fate plays a prank and he had to be separated from his family at a young age. This made him decide to go out in search of his true birthplace. Fate, however, has led him to fall in love with Petchwasee, a noble woman with a good heart How will the story of a love triangle, 1 woman, 2 men become a blood battle this time, and will the secret of the hidden birthplace be revealed?
title: Love and Fortune

overview: I Literally Just Told You is the only game show in history where the contestants are given every answer with the questions written, literally, as the show is happening. You just need to pay attention to everything that's going on. With each correct answer adding more cash to their prize pot, can the competitors keep their focus and remember the things they've seen and heard just minutes before? In the dramatic finale, the remaining two contestants set each other questions. It's a chaotic battle of wits.
title: I Literally Just Told You

overview: Monty and the team celebrate the joy that the gardening year brings.
title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials

overview: A selection of the nation's best-loved toys and games, through the decades.
title: Britain's Favourite Toys

overview: Highlights of the pop concert held at London's O2.
title: Capital Jingle Bell Ball

overview: The surprising stories and rivalries behind groundbreaking innovations and the larger-than-life characters who dreamt them up.
title: Machines That Built the World

overview: Tracy Borman investigates the rise of Thomas Cromwell from the son of a Putney blacksmith to Henry VIII's right hand man.
title: Thomas Cromwell: A Very Modern Tudor

overview: Jamie Oliver prepares festive treats the whole family can share.
title: Jamie: Together at Christmas

overview: This SOKO is like the city of Potsdam itself - warm-hearted and honest. The friendship of the detectives shapes their investigations and sometimes makes things pop during the hunt for criminals.
title: SOKO Potsdam

overview: The Hamburg detectives investigate between modern city flair and down-to-earth country life. The exciting cases often take them across the Elbe to Schleswig-Holstein and Lower Saxony.
title: SOKO Hamburg

overview: An offbeat black comedy trilogy about, in Les Dawson's own words, "a man coming from nowhere, going nowhere" and what happens to him in transit.
title: The Loner

overview: Lieutenant Colonel Medvedev has been working in the police for the last few days. Firstly, the RUBOP, in which Nikolai gave twenty years of his life to serve, was decided to be disbanded, and secondly, Medvedev, succumbing to the insistence of his wife, was going to retire from the police force based on his years of service. On the eve of his dismissal, the operative has to participate in an operation to apprehend a dangerous criminal - a famous killer nicknamed Harness. Realizing that this seasoned criminal will effortlessly bypass the ambush, Medvedev decides to detain him on his own, and he succeeds. This incident decisively changes his fate. Nikolai is summoned by his boss, General Kireev, and offers to head the new experimental department. Medvedev and his employees will have to protect witnesses whose lives and health are being threatened in connection with the investigation of certain criminal cases.
title: Государственная защита

overview: Eight teams compete to create the best possible Christmas atmosphere, but what tasks are hidden behind the hatches in Alle mot Alles unique Christmas calendar?
title: Alle mot Alle Julespesial

overview: This series is loaded with mind-blowing factoids and stats, entertaining expert interviews, and infographics injected with cheeky humor.
title: History by the Numbers

overview: Abby Walker's husband is murdered before her eyes. On her quest for revenge, Abby crosses paths with Hoyt Rawlins. Abby and Hoyt's journey takes them to Independence, Texas, where they encounter residents running from their own pasts.
title: Walker: Independence

overview: The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares are brought to life in vivid, blood-curdling style on My Haunted House. Told via gripping first person interviews and strikingly crafted re-enactments, each episode of this nerve-wracking new series tells two, compelling horror stories of people literally living in terror.
title: My Haunted House

overview: Built at strategic points, and fitted with impressive fortifications and ingenious systems to counter attacks, fortresses are thought to be impenetrable. And yet, certain skillful warlords have successfully stormed them. How did they manage this? By recounting how some of the most remarkable sieges - in ancient times or in medieval history - played out, this series revisits the construction of these megastructures and reveals the different strategies used to lay or to endure a siege. Thanks to CGI, dramatized scenes, and with the help of key experts, it immerses us in the compelling confrontation between the construction genius of the military strategists and the ingenuity of some exceptional warriors.
title: Forteresses assiégées, batailles de légende

overview: David and Annie attempt to bring Annie's teen brother and cousin to the US.
title: David & Annie: After the 90 Days

overview: Loren and Alexei get ready to take on life with two under 2!
title: Loren & Alexei: After the 90 Days

overview: In the early 1950's, the American military presence begins in a small West German region. In this context, the story of friendship is told by two young women who try to find their place in this time of upheaval. In doing so, they have to struggle again and again with the old order, the conservative forces from politics, church and society. Also playing an important role is the love story with a black soldier, who experiences freedom for the first time in Germany, but has to struggle with racist hostility.
title: Ein Hauch von Amerika

overview: Four 112 dispatchers are faced with the most extraordinary emergencies to deal with under great pressure. They attend to callers in telephone conversations that are far from mundane. Conversations that you hope you never have to have in your life, but which are the order of the day for the dispatchers. From the perspectives of the control room and the caller, decisions are made on the spot that can make the difference between life and death. Every conversation is a battle against time.
title: NOOD

overview: A five year old dragon bird hybrid spends time with her friends at her grandmother's daycare learning new things each day.
title: Wimzie's House

overview: Alex Guarnaschelli is one of the most accomplished and revered chefs in the culinary arena, having won virtually every battle she has ever competed in. Now, over the course of five weeks, 15 brave chefs from across the United States take their best shot at beating Alex for the ultimate culinary triumph in the new competition series, Alex vs America. Hosted by the acclaimed chef Eric Adjepong, each episode features three culinary superstars competing over two rounds against one another as well as against Alex. These competitors might hail from different states, but they all share the same mastery of a specific ingredient or dish, one that they have spent endless hours in their own kitchens perfecting and which will now be tested in an effort to take down one of the country's most formidable chefs. At the start of each battle, Alex and the competitors learn what the challenge will be, with the chefs having the ability to work together in selecting variables for their dishes as well as the amount of time they give themselves and Alex to cook with. Each finished plate will undergo a blind tasting, with only the top three chefs advancing and the least successful from the challenge being immediately sent home, even if it is Alex. In the end, it all comes down to what's on the plate. Will the final two chefs outcook and outshine Alex, earning bragging rights over an award-winning Iron Chef? Or will Alex's legendary winning streak continue, sending all the ambitious competitors home with nothing but their disappointment?
title: Alex vs America

overview: Summer Camp is a fun-filled and escapist series sending die-hard campers back to the most cherished place of their youth for the thrill of a lifetime.
title: Summer Camp

overview: The drama series that goes back in time to chronicle the professional and personal lives of the 1980s Los Angeles Lakers, one of sports' most revered and dominant dynasties. The show takes a look at a team that defined its era, both on and off the court. Based on Jeff Pearlman's book, Showtime: Magic, Kareem, Riley, and the Los Angeles Lakers, and executive produced by Adam McKay
title: Winning Time: The Rise of the Lakers Dynasty

overview: Surrounded by family and friends, Zezé Di Camargo and daughter Wanessa spend time together and collaborate creatively in this exclusive reality series.
title: É O Amor: Família Camargo

overview: Carlos Sainz has turned 59 years old. While rivals of his generation have already hung up the helmet, he continues at the highest level, year after year. His story is an example of perseverance. Two-time world rally champion and three-time Dakar winner, his ambition knows no bounds. We live with him the most hectic year of his, which has also meant the debut of his son, Carlos, as a Ferrari driver.
title: Sainz: Live to Compete

overview: The drama centers around President Eva Ortiz, a decorated war veteran and the nation's first Latina president, who, after surviving an assassination attempt, embarks on an undercover mission to expose the people responsible.
title: Sky on Fire

overview: In contradiction to the perfection and glamour they portray on social media, two fashionistas live a harsh reality and suffer constant turmoil.
title: Confessions of a Fashionista

overview: This "Tiger King" docuseries details disturbing allegations of sexual abuse, violence and misconduct by big cat zoo owner Bhagavan "Doc" Antle.
title: Tiger King: The Doc Antle Story

overview: Five experts in lifestyle, fashion, beauty, health and design — known as the Fab Five — dazzle a nation and transform lives in this makeover series.
title: Queer Eye Germany

overview: From the breakdown of his relationship with the mother of his children, to the death of his brother and partner Real," the last few years have been personally tough for Kamal Chance Givens. However, the original Stallionaire is now ready to get back on his horse to give love another shot. During Chance return to reality television we'll watch as he goes it alone to find the true love of his life in this new dating competition series.
title: One Mo' Chance

overview: Jin Xiao Yu, a girl with a strange illness, meets the mysterious fashion designer Jiang Bai Jiu during a bus accident. In search of the truth behind the mystery, Xiao Yu and Bai Ju heal each other and fall in love.
title: I Am the Years You Are the Stars

overview: Henry Hart's afterschool job? Kid Danger: Captain Man's superhero sidekick. Fighting crime AND finishing homework? Villains, beware!
title: Henry Danger

overview: In The Adventures of Pete & Pete, Pete and Pete are two redheaded brothers living in the somewhat surreal town of Wellsville. Pete, the older of the two, narrates the stories about their adventures in everyday life.
title: The Adventures of Pete & Pete

overview: Through the Darkness is about a criminal profiler who struggles to read the minds of serial killers. Song Ha Young is a criminal profiler. He is calm and has charisma. He digs up cases and looks deeply into the human mind.
title: Through the Darkness

overview: Chara is devastated when she finds out that the guy she loved so much has unexpectedly passed away. Not knowing how she can find the strength to continue living without him, Ra Ri decides to follow her boyfriend after death. The list of common desires that she wrote with him many years ago inspires her to refrain from death for a while longer. Ra Ri decides to fulfill all the items on this list. On her way, she meets Kang Han Sol, an idol trainee with great potential, but a strong stage fright. Brought together by fate, Ra Ri and Han Sol begin to fulfill the wishes from the list together, and the time spent together gives them the strength to hold out for some more time. Ra Ri and Han Sol begin to realize that unexpected feelings are growing between them and the pain they both experienced is slowly subsiding. Will these feelings give them the strength they need to continue living, no matter what? Adapted from the webtoon of the same name.
title: Her Bucket List

overview: A love story full of pain and happiness with Jinyan and Song Qin Chun. The two overcome past grievances to be together again.
title: Meeting You Loving You

overview: 1990s. A young financier is transporting his company's funds, but his girlfriend sets him up and robs him. On the run, he will spend many years trying to rise from the depths and find his betrayer.
title: Женские мечты о дальних странах

overview: When it comes to matters of the heart, Xiao Xiao considers himself an expert. Xiao Xiao is a blogger who deals with all kinds of relationship problems without lacking experience when it comes to love. However, all her experience on the Internet cannot prepare her for the first meeting with Lin Shen, a professional psychologist who sees the world in a completely different way. These two are invited to one reality show, but they can't find a common language. After the show, she hoped she would never have to deal with him again. But fate, as it turned out, had other plans. Hoping to improve his ability to analyze emotional problems by studying with a real professional, Xiao Xiao applies for the position of assistant professional psychologist. Too late, she realizes that the professional she works for is none other than the heartless Lin Shen. Despite the initial differences, they not only respect each other, but also understand that working together, they can help their clients overcome a number of serious problems. But will working together help them sort out their own complicated feelings?
title: Dream Garden

overview: Long before the Internet escaped from the lab, connecting the planet and redefining what it meant to meant to be a computer user... ...there was a brave and pioneering band of hobbyists who spent their time, money and sanity setting up their home computers and phone lines to welcome anyone who called. By using a modem, anyone who knew the phone number of these machines could connect to them, leave messages, play games, send and receive files in a virtual community... and millions did. They called these places "Bulletin Board Systems", or BBSes. Their collections of messages, rants thoughts and dreams became the way that an entire generation learned about being online.
title: BBS: The Documentary

overview: Prepare your jaws! Tom Cavalcante and Clarice Falcão bring together 10 comedians for a six-hour competition in which they can't laugh, but have to make others laugh.
title: LOL: Se Rir, Já Era

overview: When Yulia's father starts having problems with his business, he moves the family from St. Petersburg to Vyborg. Yulia finds herself in a new school, but her classmates are hostile to her. She meets Tema and Fred, who turn out to be members of a strange online group. The group is led online by an unknown person, Gurd. They hold events designed to teach arrogant classmates a lesson. But the pranks of new friends soon cease to be innocent. Julia decides to leave the group, but it turns out that it is too late. It is no longer teenage schoolchildren who are being targeted, but their parents...
title: Там, где нас нет

overview: Wake up to Eamonn Holmes and Isabel Webster as they bring you the Great British Breakfast. It's your daily dose of news, politics, sport and entertainment. It's news with opinion.
title: Breakfast with Eamonn & Isabel

overview: Convicted of murdering his wife and child, he wakes up one day with amnesia and doesn't know why he's in prison, a prosecutor seeking to regain his memory and clear his name.
title: Mahkum

overview: Set amidst the glamor of the global elite, Death and Other Details centers on the brilliant and restless Imogene Scott, who finds herself in the wrong place/wrong time (okay, it was kinda her fault) and becomes the prime suspect in a locked room murder mystery. The setting? A lavishly restored Mediterranean ocean liner. Suspects? Every pampered guest and every exhausted crew member. The problem? To prove her innocence, she must partner with a man she despises - Rufus Cotesworth, the world's greatest detective.
title: Death and Other Details
Сердце не обманет, сердце не предаст

overview: Ed Poole's life isn't going as he planned. However, a tragic event causes him to rethink his outlook, forcing him to go after what he loves, cherish the people closest to him and live in The Now.
title: The Now

overview: In this funny and revealing comedy panel series, real-life married couples take center stage as their quirky, funny and relatable disputes are explored, examined - and ultimately judged. The couples will appear in-studio and face a panel of "experts" composed of top celebrities and comedians who will weigh in and decide which spouse is right. The goal is to give couples something they have always wanted but have never had - a clear winner.
title: The Marriage Ref

overview: The mini-drama shows the realities of modern relationships. The story of a couple in love - a shy girl who has not yet learned to speak directly about her desires, and her young man, who, like many guys, does not understand hints. Ahead of the couple in love, there are many difficulties, ups and downs that will affect the modern realities of our life.
title: Straight Sassy

overview: This short lived show is about a rich heiress who wanted nothing more to do than spend money. But her Uncle Simon is keeping a tight hand on the wallet. Her twin brother Terrence and her housekeeper Mrs. Ratchett are also an irritation to Tammy.
title: The Tammy Grimes Show

overview: This documentary series delves into the Iran–Iraq War led by Khomeini and Saddam Hussein, revisiting key moments and exploring the leaders' motives.
title: The Iran-Iraq War

overview: Lacey is a prolific lawyer for the rich and powerful in Los Angeles who can make anyone's problems disappear--except her own, which often blurs the lines between right and wrong.
title: Lace

overview: In Veipatruljen you meet Oslo's tough car rescuers, who are always at work to help unlucky drivers and make a huge effort to clear the roads, and ensure accessibility for residents.
title: Veipatruljen

overview: We meet the colorful artists who work at Attitude, one of Norway's busiest and most renowned tattoo studios.
title: Tatovørene

overview: Ole Martin Alfsen shows you step by step how to easily make different dishes.
title: Ole Martins kjøkken

overview: Ten dedicated firefighters from all over the country will compete both individually and as a team, and they will face challenges that push them to the limit. After seven episodes, one fire constable will remain the winner, and can travel home to their fire station with a brand new emergency vehicle.
title: Norges Beste Brannmann

overview: Join us when Petter Stordalen opens Norway's largest hotel, Clarion Hotel The Hub, right in the center of Oslo.
title: Hotelleventyret

overview: We choose the ultimate Christmas drink! A panel consisting of Rikke Isaksen and Niklas Baarli, led by Fridtjof Nilsen, will taste a new drink every day until Christmas. The drink has of course been selected and served by real Norwegian celebrities.
title: Juleølkalenderen

overview: The competition, where time equals money, will air in primetime, live from a gigantic hourglass shaped structure in the heart of Manhattan. This hourglass will also serve as the living quarters of the reigning champions – the four players who have remained in the game the longest. They will have the opportunity to play along with the game for up to two weeks as other contestants attempt to unseat them during the primetime show.
title: The Million Second Quiz

overview: In the series Jegertvillingene we follow Kristine and Johanne on their first trip out into the world to hunt and fish. In the TV series, we join them in new hunting grounds in the United States, from Florida's swamps to the Idaho wilderness. Here they meet like-minded hunters, new forms of hunting and animals they have never seen before.
title: Jegertvillingene

overview: Sam and Jade are psyched to spend their summer riding the waves and catching the rays. That is until they meet a ghost. The girls dive head-first into a mystery about a pirate ship and the cursed treasure that allegedly lies beneath Surfside's beloved Danger Point bluff. After meeting a pirate ghost named Remi, Sam wants to help him break the curse while Jade is determined to find a scientific explanation for the existence of ghosts. To solve the mystery, Sam and Jade will need to combine their very different approaches of logic and imagination. Together, they are determined to connect the clues, solve the mystery and save Surfside... and maybe they'll help a couple of pirate ghosts along the way.
title: Surfside Girls

overview: New York City natives and rap personalities Alec "Despot" Reinstein, Ashok "Dap" Kondabolu and Aleksey "Lakutis" Weintraub invite their friends to join them at the edge of nature. To commune in deserts and swamps in a valiant effort to reveal unknowable truths from the dreamstate of the shared human existence.
title: Chillin Island

overview: Every Sunday morning, 10 young men in Silkeborg gather to sing in a church choir. Over the years, the group have formed a close bond, and after the bells fall silent, they meet to push their limits and test the forbidden pleasures of adult life. But when one of the boys drowns under mysterious circumstances, their unity and loyalty are put to the ultimate test.
title: Drenge

overview: Mutasim "Mutta" Billah visits twelve high schools. In each place, three students will learn all about one sex topic and become the school's own "sex experts".
title: Sexpertene

overview: We follow Norwegians who have found love across national borders. What is it like to be head over heels in love with someone who lives in and comes from a different country and a completely different culture?
title: Grenseløst forelsket

overview: Who is Linni Meister behind the flashlights - and what is she really living off? Now Linni opens the doors to her busy everyday life.
title: Linnis univers

overview: Ronny Brede Aase and Lise Finckenhagen bring ten celebrities to Tuscany.
title: Den store matfesten – Toscana

overview: Sara discovers that Jonas is carrying a dark secret. How far is Jonas willing to go to gain recognition in the right-wing extremist forums he frequents? And is it possible for Sara to still see the person behind all the thoughts she cannot understand or accept?
title: Alt du elsker

overview: Parts of Norway's gay history are seen through the eyes and hearts of more than 50 famous Norwegians.
title: UT

overview: Great fantasy is filled with adventure, challenges, discovery, fish out of water and good vs. evil — turns out, another modern genre shares these exact same traits. Announcing The Quest, a reality show that literally takes contestants and audiences to an amazing, imaginative realm, where the ogres are advancing in the woods, the dragons are stirring, agents of a dark lord are infiltrating the keep, and the only thing that stands between peace and chaos are 12 very unlikely heroes. From the producers of The Lord of the Rings trilogy, paired with the producers of The Amazing Race, The Quest is a fully immersive experience. In and around this castle, our fantasy realm comes to life with state-of-the art projections, animatronics, prosthetics, real-time motion capture and art direction. The narrative and mythology of The Quest is deep and fully imagined, and it was designed to incorporate seamlessly with the unexpected actions and decisions of our contestants – fantasy comes alive as it never has before in this genre-bending series.
title: The Quest

overview: We follow the Oslo Police District's 'Section for Traffic and Maritime Services' on assignments in and around the capital. The police car Tango 38 is almost always out in the busy streets of Oslo to ensure the safety of the population and to fight crime.
title: Politiet - Tango 38

overview: They have a single goal: to find the missing person. Regardless. When the police sound the alarm, the volunteers and their rescue dogs rush out to search.
title: Redningshundene

overview: We follow Emil and Silas through various challenges to find out once and for all which of them is the best Funkytwin.
title: Den beste Funkytwin

overview: Months of dating are compressed down to one week, when five hopeful suitors move in with their fiancées, to compete to be the one left when the week is over. Along the way, they have to compete in competitions, quizzes and activities. They must also try to impress both the group of friends and their possible future in-laws!
title: 5 i uka

overview: 123 people died when the housing platform Alexander L. Kielland walked around the North Sea in 1980. Survivors and those left behind still have many questions. What really happened?
title: Katastrofen Kielland

overview: Dennis Lynn Rader, also known as "BTK," an acronym he gave himself standing for "Blind, Torture, Kill," is one of the most infamous killers in recent American history. BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer, a two-part documentary event, examines the horrific crimes and psyche of the notorious serial killer and provides unprecedented access into the mind of Rader, who is currently serving 10 consecutive life sentences in El Dorado Correctional Facility. "BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer" sheds new light on Rader's double life as both an upstanding citizen and a heartless killer, showcasing the intimate details of Rader's past and his gruesome murders while providing insight on how to better identify and potentially deter extreme violent offenders in the future.
title: BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer

overview: An erotic suspense BL series exploring the lives of four couples as they navigate through love, pain, loss, romance, forgiveness, redemption, loneliness and sorrow. After reports from NASA confirm that an asteroid is set to hit Earth in 7 days resulting in global catastrophe, priorities quickly change and panic ensues.
title: Love at the End of the World

overview: Asia Artist Awards (abbreviated AAA) is an awards ceremony organized by South Korea-based business newspaper Money Today and its global media brands StarNews and MTN. It honors outstanding achievements and international contributions of Asian artists in television, film and music.
title: Asia Artist Awards

overview: Six horror themed spoofs introduced by Steve Coogan as the evil Dr. Terrible. The stories look at vampires, Fu Manchu, mad scientists, a voodoo curse and witchcraft.
title: Dr. Terrible's House of Horrible

overview: The story of three women who together are forced to manage a car service that they inherited after the death of their father. Once he separated his daughters by his behavior and made them strangers. Now his provincial car business must rally the quarreling sisters. Olga, a teacher, Masha, a hairdresser, and Irina, a businesswoman, will lead a team of forty men, simultaneously resolving the contradictions that have accumulated over the years.
title: Сёстры
